label: D1 after a rewarded trial, early in the episode, while the policy leans to a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (the previous trial was rewarded). On the dev split, phase==D1 & in_rew==1 covers 100% of activations but has 0.15 precision. Nearly every activation falls in episode trials 0-49 (it is close to silent after trial 50), and adding ep_trial<50 raises precision to 0.32. The feature also prefers a1: about 80% of activation mass is on trials where the upcoming choice is a1 and good is S1. The observed version of that preference is the model policy logit at this D1 step (choice > 2.78, a moderate lean to a1), which beats using the future next action (F1 0.76 vs 0.64). Activations also sit in a narrow value-head band (7.54-7.73). Dev F1 is 0.76 (P 0.74, R 0.78, mass recall 0.74). It does not fire at GO or D2, after unrewarded trials, or late in the episode. It is weak or absent at D1 steps inside long reward streaks, where the value is higher. Magnitude is not explained: the strongest activations come after rare rewarded transitions in either direction, often with the next choice a2, so the top quartile is the least covered (0.68). Recorded predicate uses only observed variables and the model own policy output.
